title: Continuous compactly supported maps are dense in L¹ of a finite measure on ℝ^N (Step 4 of the supplied proof)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let E be a real normed space (E : Type with NormedAddCommGroup E and NormedSpace ℝ E), let ν be a finite measure on ℝ^N = Eucl N with its Borel σ-algebra (IsFiniteMeasure ν), and let f : ℝ^N → E belong to L¹(ν) (MemLp f 1 ν). Then for every ε ∈ [0, ∞] with ε ≠ 0 there is g : ℝ^N → E such that g has compact support (HasCompactSupport g), ‖f − g‖_{L¹(ν)} = eLpNorm (f − g) 1 ν ≤ ε, g is continuous and g ∈ L¹(ν) (MemLp g 1 ν).
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (ν : Measure (Eucl N)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (f : Eucl N → E), MemLp f 1 ν → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, ε ≠ 0 → ∃ g : Eucl N → E, HasCompactSupport g ∧ eLpNorm (f - g) 1 ν ≤ ε ∧ Continuous g ∧ MemLp g 1 ν
